issues.description: The solution marks Course.addRating(stars:) as private, but the Client (in the solution) calls this method from a different file. The problem statement and the template expect addRating to be callable by clients (no private restriction). Making the method private prevents external use and will cause a compile/access error when Client calls addRating, which contradicts the intended exercise flow.
issues.suggestedFix: Make addRating(stars:) non-private (remove the private modifier) so it is accessible to Client and other callers within the module, matching the template and problem expectations. Alternatively, if intended to be restricted, update the Client usage and problem statement to use an allowed public/internal API.
